note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 6.3 ("If any of the well-known mandatory attributes are not recognized, then the Error Subcode MUST be set to Unrecognized Well-known Attribute. The Data field MUST contain the unrecognized attribute (type, length, and value).", retained as session reset under RFC 7606). TestSessionRFC4271RetainedUpdateNotifications drives an established eBGP Session over net.Pipe: negative first accepts the same type code 250 marked Optional (0xd0) with its NLRI; positive then sends well-known code 250 ([0x50, 250, 0, 2, 0xab, 0xcd]) and asserts ReadAndProcess errors, exact NOTIFICATION [3, 2, 0x50, 250, 0, 2, 0xab, 0xcd] on the socket, and StateIdle.
